note: The machine copy of the metric and baseline catalog. evaluate.py reads its metric rows, its threshold-dependent set and its baseline definitions from here rather than holding a second copy in code; tests/test_catalog_sync.py fails when this file and the prose diverge.

binary.primary: pr_auc when the train minority share is below 0.3, else roc_auc — as the spec's metrics.primary says

planned.note: build obligation C9: neither built nor planned by the pytorch backend (its coverage.json planned note says so); a spec that names one is refused by compile_spec's rule B2, so this stage never reports them

anomaly.primary: pr_auc on the score when a label exists, else anomaly_score_mean

upstream_numbers: the selected run's valid metrics from the ledger

mape.rule: |y| > 0.1 for 99 % of the train part's rows
mape.why: a percentage error divides by the truth: on a target near zero it measures the denominator, not the model

trivial.definition: majority class / class prior (classification), the mean (regression), the mean row (reconstruction)
trivial.why: the floor every metric is read against; a network below it is broken

by_shape.window: the train target's mean (values) or the class prior, whatever the window holds
by_shape.graph-node: the prior / mean of the train nodes' labels
by_shape.graph-level: the prior / mean of the train graphs' labels

linear.definition: logistic regression / ridge on the shaped features, L2 chosen on valid

by_task.unsupervised: PCA reconstruction at the network's bottleneck size (the pca-floor)
by_task.anomaly: PCA reconstruction at the network's bottleneck size (the pca-floor)

linear.why: the linear floor: what the network's non-linearity buys

by_shape.window: on the flattened window (L·F′ + L·C columns)
by_shape.graph-node: on the node's own features — structure-blind, and named so
by_shape.graph-level: on the [mean | max | sum]-pooled node features of each graph

tree.definition: gradient-boosted trees, depth and rounds chosen on valid with early stopping

by_task.anomaly: isolation forest (an anomaly task without a label has nothing to boost against)
by_task.unsupervised: not defined for reconstruction, and the row says so

tree.why: the honest tabular contender; on most tabular sets it is the number to beat

by_shape.window: on the flattened window (L·F′ + L·C columns)
by_shape.graph-node: on the node's own features — structure-blind, and named so
by_shape.graph-level: on the [mean | max | sum]-pooled node features of each graph

lens.definition: the algorithm and protocol /data-lens's importance module recorded, re-fitted here on the shaped features
lens.why: continuity with the analysis's learnability estimate, on the features the network saw

campaign-baseline.definition: the network's own R0 run — the spec as engineered
campaign-baseline.why: what the ladder and the search bought

naive.definition: persistence: the last observed target, repeated over the horizon (a sequence regression repeats the row before the anchor)
naive.why: the forecast floor: a network that cannot beat yesterday's value has learned nothing about the series

seasonal-naive.definition: seasonal persistence: horizon step h repeats the target s·⌈h/s⌉ rows before it, s = sample.season
seasonal-naive.why: the floor of a seasonal series: a network that cannot beat last season's value has learned only the season

graph-linear.definition: logistic / ridge on [x ‖ mean of the in-neighbours' x] over the scored view's edges — one fixed propagation (SGC-style)
graph-linear.why: the honest contender at node level: what learned message passing bought over one fixed propagation, where linear and tree are structure-blind
